reported.title: RPM line printed in wrong format
reported.description: printRpm() at lines 45-46 emits "rpm: " (lowercase, with a space after the colon) instead of the required "RPM:<n>". The measured evidence confirms no serial line matched /^RPM:[0-9]+$/ across all 8.00 s of every scenario, so the required once-per-second RPM line never appears in the specified format. No serial line matched /^RPM:[0-9]+$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

reported.title: Printed rpm value cannot be parsed or verified
reported.description: Because printRpm() at lines 45-46 uses the wrong prefix and separator, no line matches /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/, so the measured evidence reports "no parsable serial value" for the whole run. Additionally readRpm() at line 21 scales raw counts by 5000/1023 mV, which is the ADC full-scale voltage rather than the 1 mV/rpm tach scale, so even a correctly formatted value would not track the injected rpm. No serial line matched /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A5.

truth.description: Prints rpm: with space instead of RPM:

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^RPM:' every 1000 ms (RPM: lines)
serial values for 'RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)' match the stimulus (tolerance 50) (rpm value)

judge_input.spec:
- Tach input on A5 at 1 mV per rpm; over-speed lamp on D9; mute on D3 (pull-up).
- Print `RPM:<n>` with no space after the colon once per second (1000 ms ±120 ms).
- Printed rpm must stay within ±50 of the injected tach value.
- Light D9 when rpm is at or above 2000 while mute is released.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep D9 OFF regardless of rpm.
- Each second also print `spindle min=<n> max=<n>` after the RPM line.
